findings.key_quote: In 2025, the Company recorded other operating charges of $ 1,261 million. findings.justification: This evidence from the 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 (EXACT_MATCH period) explicitly states that operating charges in 2025 included trademark impairments totaling $1,044 million ($960M BodyArmor + $44M Latin America + $41M Asia Pacific which includes trademark).
